capabilities: Navigate to linked notes via Ctrl/⌘+click on flowchart nodes
Edit flowcharts visually with changes written back to the Mermaid source
Pan and zoom diagrams with auto-saved view state
Export diagrams as SVG and high-res PNG
Auto-create missing linked notes in a configured folder and sync links on rename
disambiguation: The name suggests navigation only, but it also provides visual flowchart editing and image export.
extras: The README is primarily in Chinese with a shorter English section. Taking over native Mermaid code blocks requires a plugin reload after changing the setting; only the first link in a node is clickable and link labels on edge arrows are not.
intentEvidence: 接管原生 mermaid 代码块
problem: Obsidian's built-in Mermaid rendering shows diagrams as static images with no way to click nodes to open linked notes or edit the chart visually.

relations.evidence: 当前节点的选择跨设备同步（通过坚果云等同步插件同步状态文件）

requires.name: 坚果云 (Nutstore) or another sync plugin

summary: Mermaid renderer that makes flowchart nodes clickable [[wikilinks]], with right-click visual editing, canvas zoom/pan, and SVG/PNG export.
